svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: cable measurement in transmission (the normal case, loss between the two
What to draw: the VNA on the left with P1 and P2 on the right side (or on the sides). The cable
under test in the middle, drawn clearly visible and folded or wavy to show that it is the
device under test (DUT). One end of the cable goes to P1, the other to P2, each with a short
test lead (the test leads are those used for the calibration).
Details: the two test leads identical and short; the two ends of the cable labelled A and B (A
on P1, B on P2); a small mark showing the calibration planes (the two ends of the test leads,
where the cable under test is attached).
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
